articles.title: Strive says digital credit selloff was a liquidation event, not a credit crisis
articles.snippet: A sharp selloff in digital credit products exposed growing pains in a young market, a Strive executive argues the underlying credit fundamentals remain intact.

articles.title: Anchorage aims to bring banks onchain with new tokenized deposit platform
articles.snippet: The crypto bank aims to help financial institutions offer round-the-clock payments and settlement without replacing their core systems.

articles.title: Bitcoin mining network becoming more sensitive to price swings, JPMorgan says
articles.snippet: A growing share of miners are operating near breakeven levels, making hashrate and mining difficulty increasingly responsive to bitcoin's price movements, the bank said.

articles.title: TradFi fund manager Baillie Gifford introduces Solana, Ethereum tokenized fund with BNY
articles.snippet: Baillie Gifford Enhanced Yield Fund (BAGEY) is denominated in dollars, and gives eligible investors access to an actively managed, short-duration portfolio of public corporate bonds.

articles.title: Live markets: Bitcoin gives up morning gains as Nasdaq sheds more than 1%
articles.snippet: Eased ETF selling and improving risk appetite are being offset by a firmer dollar and cautious institutional flows, leaving bitcoin range-bound, one analyst said.
